title: Same salary. One bought a car, one invested $500/mo

scenes.text: Two friends. Same salary. Ten years later, one has $91,000... and the other has a used car.
Mike gets his first big paycheck and buys a brand new car. $650 a month, for six years.
Jake keeps his old car. Instead, every month, he puts $500 into a simple index fund. Boring? Totally.
Mike's car? Worth about $12,000 now. And he's still paying for gas and repairs.
Jake's boring $500 a month? At an 8% average return, it grew to over $91,000.
He only put in $60,000. The market added the other $31,000.
Same salary. Different first move. Pay yourself first, then spend what's left.
